name: mod-surfer
description: Subway Surfers-style runner pane, rendered in three.js, that runs while Claude works; each run's output tokens go to a shared leaderboard

leaderboard.title: Post runs to the leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Each finished run's output tokens, coins and length go up under your player name

playerName.title: Player name
playerName.description: The name your runs go up under. Empty: your git user.name

leaderboardUrl.title: Leaderboard URL
leaderboardUrl.description: Where runs are posted. Empty: runs are not posted

sfx.title: Sound effects
sfx.description: Synthesized coin, jump and crash sounds while the game runs (macOS)
